<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>印刷报价系统 · 业务应用</title>
<style>
:root{
  --accent:#2F5D50;--ink:#171613;--muted:#716D64;--faint:#9A958B;--bg:#F6F3EC;
  --card:#FFFFFF;--line:#DDD8CD;--soft:#EFEBE2;--ok:#2E7D5B;--warn:#B4782A;--bad:#B4462F;
  --radius:14px;--shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.04),0 12px 32px rgba(20,18,14,.06);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
body{font:14px/1.6 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}

.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.topbar-in{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;height:68px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;padding:0 26px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:0 0 auto}
.brand-mark{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.6px;box-shadow:0 6px 16px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 24%,transparent)}
.brand-text b{display:block;font-size:20px;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.01em}
.brand-text span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:1.6px;margin-top:4px}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-left:6px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.nav button{padding:9px 13px;border-radius:9px;color:#4D4A43;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
.nav button:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.nav button.on{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.top-actions{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:0 0 auto}
.search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:0 11px;height:38px;min-width:210px}
.search svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--faint);flex:0 0 auto}
.search input{border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;width:100%;font-size:13px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;height:38px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;transition:.15s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn:hover{border-color:#BDB6A8;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 20px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 22%,transparent)}
.btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
.btn.dark{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.btn.danger{background:#fff;border-color:#E2BEB4;color:var(--bad)}
.btn.sm{height:31px;padding:0 11px;font-size:12px;border-radius:8px}
.btn.block{width:100%}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}
.icon-btn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px}
.user-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:38px;padding:0 8px 0 5px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:#fff}
.avatar{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;flex:0 0 auto}
.user-chip b{font-size:12px;max-width:88px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

.page{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:34px 26px 70px}
.page.narrow{max-width:980px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(320px,.85fr);gap:28px;align-items:stretch;margin-bottom:34px}
.hero-card{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:42px 44px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:330px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hero-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-90px;top:-110px;width:330px;height:330px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.hero-card:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:60px;bottom:-140px;width:280px;height:280px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.hero-card>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.eyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);font-weight:700}
.hero-card .eyebrow{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.hero h1{font-size:40px;line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:14px 0 16px;font-weight:700}
.hero-card h1{color:#fff;font-size:38px}
.hero p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.9;color:#5E5A52;margin:0;max-width:520px}
.hero-card p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-size:13.5px}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-card .btn{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-color:#fff}
.hero-card .btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.hero-art{border-radius:22px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;box-shadow:var(--shadow);min-height:330px}
.hero-art-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.4px;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase}
.hero-feature{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.hero-feature .big{font-size:54px;line-height:1;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--accent)}
.hero-feature b{font-size:17px;line-height:1.45}
.hero-feature span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.hero-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;margin-top:18px}
.hero-list div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px}
.hero-list span{color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.hero-list em{font-style:normal;color:var(--faint);flex:0 0 auto}

.section{margin-top:38px}
.section-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:18px}
.section-head h2{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0;font-weight:700}
.section-head p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.chip{height:32px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-size:12px;color:#56524A}
.chip:hover{border-color:#BDB6A8}
.chip.on{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px}
.grid.four{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03);transition:.18s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:#C9C2B4}
.card-cover{height:172px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 82%,#111),var(--accent));display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:18px}
.card-cover:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 78% 18%,rgba(255,255,255,.22),transparent 42%)}
.card-cover .glyph{position:absolute;right:16px;top:10px;font-size:56px;line-height:1;font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);letter-spacing:-.05em}
.card-cover .cover-label{position:relative;z-index:1;color:#fff;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;background:rgba(0,0,0,.22);padding:5px 9px;border-radius:6px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.card-body{padding:18px 18px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;flex:1}
.card-kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.1px;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.card h3{font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.card p{margin:0;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--muted);display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.card-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--soft);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint)}
.price{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.price small{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--faint);margin-left:2px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:22px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--soft);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.pill.ok{background:#E5F2EA;color:var(--ok)}
.pill.warn{background:#F8EEDC;color:var(--warn)}
.pill.bad{background:#F7E6E1;color:var(--bad)}
.dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;display:inline-block}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.faint{color:var(--faint)}
.empty{padding:64px 20px;text-align:center;color:var(--faint);font-size:13px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);background:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.empty b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:6px}
.loading{padding:60px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--faint);font-size:13px}
.spinner{width:22px;height:22px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-top-color:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 12px;animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

.detail-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:26px}
.back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.back:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.article{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:46px 54px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}
.article .eyebrow{color:var(--accent)}
.article h1{font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC","Noto Serif SC",serif;font-size:40px;line-height:1.22;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:14px 0 18px}
.article-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;font-size:12px;color:var(--faint);padding-bottom:22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.article-cover{height:280px;border-radius:14px;margin:26px 0 30px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 80%,#111),var(--accent));position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.article-cover .glyph{position:absolute;right:30px;bottom:10px;font-size:100px;font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.16);letter-spacing:-.06em}
.article-body{font-size:15px;line-height:2;color:#34322D;word-break:break-word}
.article-body p{margin:0 0 1.2em}
.article-body h2{font-size:22px;margin:1.6em 0 .7em}
.article-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:32px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap}
.comments{margin-top:34px}
.comments h3{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 16px}
.comment{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--soft)}
.comment .avatar{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:12px}
.comment-main{min-width:0;flex:1}
.comment-main b{font-size:12.5px}
.comment-main time{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-left:8px}
.comment-main p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:#43413C;word-break:break-word}
.comment-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;align-items:start}
.comment-form textarea{min-height:82px}

.toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.toolbar .search{min-width:260px;flex:1;max-width:420px}
.toolbar .spacer{flex:1}
.table-wrap{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:620px}
th{text-align:left;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);font-weight:700;padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#FBFAF6;white-space:nowrap}
td{padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--soft);font-size:12.5px;vertical-align:middle}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
tbody tr{cursor:pointer}
tbody tr:hover{background:#FBFAF6}
td .strong{font-weight:700}
td .sub{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:2px}
.row-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pager{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--faint);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

.side-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px minmax(0,1fr);gap:28px;align-items:start}
.side-nav{position:sticky;top:90px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:10px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
.side-nav .label{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 12px 8px;font-weight:700}
.side-nav button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px;font-size:12.5px;color:#45423B;text-align:left}
.side-nav button:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.side-nav button.on{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.side-nav button span{font-size:10px;color:var(--faint)}
.side-nav button.on span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.side-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;margin-top:14px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
.side-card h4{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4px}
.side-card p{margin:0;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted)}
.stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:24px}
.stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
.stat .k{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700}
.stat .v{font-size:30px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:8px;line-height:1}
.stat .m{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:8px}
.stat.accent{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.stat.accent .k,.stat.accent .m{color:rgba(255,255,255,.68)}
.panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03);margin-bottom:20px}
.panel-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.panel-head h3{margin:0;font-size:15px}
.detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px 26px;margin:18px 0}
.detail-grid div{padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--soft);min-width:0}
.detail-grid label{display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px}
.detail-grid b{font-size:13px;word-break:break-word}

.cart-drawer{position:fixed;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:390px;max-width:92vw;background:#fff;z-index:70;box-shadow:-20px 0 60px rgba(20,18,14,.16);transform:translateX(105%);transition:.25s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.cart-drawer.open{transform:none}
.cart-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.cart-head h3{margin:0;font-size:16px}
.cart-body{padding:18px 22px;overflow:auto;flex:1}
.cart-line{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--soft);align-items:center}
.cart-line .thumb{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 60%,#111));flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-size:18px;font-weight:800}
.cart-line .info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.cart-line b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.cart-line span{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)}
.qty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;height:28px}
.qty button{width:26px;height:100%;background:#fff;font-size:13px}
.qty button:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.qty em{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;width:28px;text-align:center}
.cart-foot{padding:18px 22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:#FBFAF6}
.cart-total{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:14px}
.cart-total span{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)}
.cart-total b{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.02em}

.modal-mask{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(17,15,12,.42);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:80;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px}
.modal-mask.open{display:flex}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;width:min(560px,100%);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;padding:24px 26px 0}
.modal-head h3{margin:0;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.modal-head p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
.modal-body{padding:20px 26px 26px}
.modal-foot{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;padding:0 26px 26px}
.close{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--soft);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;color:var(--muted);flex:0 0 auto}
.form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.form .full{grid-column:1/-1}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.field label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:#fff;padding:9px 11px;outline:0;font-size:13px;transition:.15s}
.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 12%,transparent)}
.field textarea{min-height:96px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.7}
.field .hint{font-size:10px;color:var(--faint)}
.form-note{grid-column:1/-1;font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);line-height:1.7}

.chat-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:320px minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;height:calc(100vh - 150px);min-height:520px}
.chat-list{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
.chat-list-head{padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;position:sticky;top:0;background:#fff;z-index:2}
.chat-list-head b{font-size:14px}
.conv{display:flex;gap:11px;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--soft);cursor:pointer}
.conv:hover{background:#FBFAF6}
.conv.on{background:var(--soft)}
.conv .avatar{width:38px;height:38px}
.conv-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.conv-main b{font-size:12.5px;display:block}
.conv-main p{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.chat-pane{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
.chat-pane-head{padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.chat-pane-head b{font-size:14px}
.chat-pane-head span{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)}
.msgs{padding:22px;overflow:auto;flex:1;background:#FBFaf6;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.bubble{max-width:72%;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;word-break:break-word;align-self:flex-start}
.bubble.me{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.bubble time{display:block;font-size:9.5px;opacity:.62;margin-top:4px}
.chat-compose{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:14px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;align-items:flex-end}
.chat-compose textarea{flex:1;min-height:44px;max-height:130px;resize:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;outline:0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.chat-compose textarea:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.chat-empty{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;color:var(--faint);font-size:13px;padding:30px;text-align:center}

.social-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px minmax(0,1fr) 290px;gap:22px;align-items:start}
.profile-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
.profile-card .avatar{width:64px;height:64px;font-size:22px;margin:0 auto 12px}
.profile-card b{display:block;font-size:16px}
.profile-card span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:4px;word-break:break-all}
.profile-card p{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin:10px 0 0}
.composer{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
.composer-top{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
.composer .avatar{width:40px;height:40px}
.composer textarea{flex:1;min-height:86px;border:0;outline:0;resize:vertical;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75;padding:9px 0}
.composer-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:10px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--soft)}
.composer select{height:31px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;padding:0 8px;font-size:11px}
.post{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
.post-head{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.post-head .avatar{width:40px;height:40px}
.post-head b{display:block;font-size:13px}
.post-head time{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint)}
.post-body{font-size:14px;line-height:1.85;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;color:#34322D}
.post-imgs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:12px}
.post-imgs div{height:96px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 55%,#111));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-size:18px;font-weight:800}
.post-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--soft)}
.post-actions button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:7px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.post-actions button:hover{background:var(--soft);color:var(--ink)}
.post-actions button.on{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
.mini-list{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,18,14,.03)}
.mini-list h4{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.3px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.mini-person{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--soft);cursor:pointer}
.mini-person .avatar{width:32px;height:32px}
.mini-person b{display:block;font-size:11.5px}
.mini-person span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--faint)}
.notice{padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--soft);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.6}
.notice b{display:block;font-size:11.5px}
.notice span{color:var(--faint);font-size:10px}

.toast-wrap{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:28px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:100;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;align-items:center;pointer-events:none}
.toast{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18);animation:toastin .22s ease-out;max-width:88vw}
.toast.err{background:var(--bad)}
.toast.ok{background:var(--ok)}
@keyframes toastin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

.foot{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:50px;padding:24px 0;color:var(--faint);font-size:11px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}

body.mode-content{--bg:#F6F1E7;--line:#DED6C6;--soft:#EFE8DA;--card:#FFFDF8}
body.mode-content .hero h1,body.mode-content .section-head h2{font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC","Noto Serif SC",serif;font-weight:600}
body.mode-content .grid .card:nth-child(3n+1) .card-cover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2F3A35,#6E7C66)}
body.mode-content .grid .card:nth-child(3n+2) .card-cover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5A3B2E,#A66A4E)}
body.mode-content .grid .card:nth-child(3n) .card-cover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#30384A,#65748C)}
body.mode-commerce{--bg:#F7F5EF;--line:#E0DACC;--soft:#F0EBE0;--card:#fff}
body.mode-commerce .hero-card{background:#1F2A24}
body.mode-catalog{--bg:#F3F6F1;--line:#D7DED2;--soft:#E9EFE4;--card:#fff}
body.mode-desk{--bg:#F1F3F5;--line:#DCE0E4;--soft:#EBEEF1;--card:#fff;--radius:10px}
body.mode-desk .hero-card{background:#16202A}
body.mode-desk .hero h1{font-size:34px}
body.mode-desk .section-head h2{font-size:19px}
body.mode-chat{--bg:#EEF1F4;--line:#D8DDE2;--soft:#E8ECEF}
body.mode-chat .page{padding-top:22px}
body.mode-social{--bg:#F3F5F8;--line:#DCE1E7;--soft:#E9EDF2}
body.mode-social .page{padding-top:24px}

@media(max-width:1080px){
  .grid,.grid.four{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .stat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .social-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 280px}
  .social-layout>.profile-col{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px}
  .side-layout{grid-template-columns:190px minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px}
  .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-art{min-height:0}
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .topbar-in{height:auto;padding:12px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
  .nav{order:3;width:100%;margin:0}
  .search{min-width:0;flex:1}
  .brand-text b{font-size:17px}
  .page{padding:22px 16px 50px}
  .grid,.grid.four{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .stat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .article{padding:28px 22px;border-radius:14px}
  .article h1{font-size:30px}
  .social-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .side-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .side-nav{position:static}
  .chat-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;height:auto}
  .chat-list{max-height:280px}
  .chat-pane{height:480px}
  .form,.detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .comment-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-card{padding:30px 26px;min-height:0}
  .hero h1,.hero-card h1{font-size:30px}
  .cart-drawer{width:100%}
}

/* ---- 工作台 / 看板 ---- */
.page.desk{max-width:1260px}
.desk-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) 300px;gap:30px;align-items:stretch;margin-bottom:26px}
.desk-hero h1{font-size:38px;line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:12px 0 14px}
.desk-hero p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--muted);margin:0;max-width:620px}
.desk-stamp{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:8px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.desk-stamp span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint);font-weight:700}
.desk-stamp b{font-size:34px;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.desk-stamp em{font-style:normal;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
.kpi-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin:24px 0 30px}
.kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 16px 14px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.kpi:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:3px;height:100%;background:var(--accent)}
.kpi span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--faint);display:block}
.kpi b{font-size:30px;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.04em;display:block;margin-top:8px}
.kpi em{font-style:normal;font-size:10px;color:var(--faint);display:block;margin-top:6px}
.board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;align-items:start}
.board-col{background:#EFEBE2;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;min-height:220px}
.board-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:4px 6px 10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.board-head span{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:1px 7px}
.board-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 11px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer}
.board-card b{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}
.board-card span{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:5px}
.breadcrumb-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:20px}
.empty-state{padding:60px 20px;text-align:center;color:var(--faint);font-size:13px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:22px;padding:0 8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--soft);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---- 聊天 ---- */
.chat-page .chat-shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:300px minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px;min-height:calc(100vh - 190px);align-items:stretch}
.chat-side{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.chat-side-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.chat-side-head span{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint)}
.chat-side-list{flex:1;overflow:auto;min-height:300px}
.chat-side-empty{padding:40px 18px;text-align:center;color:var(--faint);font-size:12px}
.chat-new{margin:12px}
.chat-main{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);min-height:420px}
.chat-empty{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;text-align:center;padding:36px;color:var(--faint)}
.chat-empty .big-mark{width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em}
.chat-empty h2{font-size:24px;color:var(--ink);margin:10px 0 0}

function esc(v) {
  return String(v == null ? '' : v)
    .replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, ''');
}

/* 行内事件里的字符串参数：JSON 转义后还要做 HTML 属性转义，避免 onclick="App.f(\"x\")" 截断属性 */
function HQ(v) {
  return String(JSON.stringify(v == null ? '' : v))

}
App.esc = esc;

function storeGet(key, fallback) {
  try { const v = localStorage.getItem(key); return v == null ? fallback : JSON.parse(v); } catch (e) { return fallback; }
}
function storeSet(key, value) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
}

function ifaceOf(name) {
  return (CASE.interfaces || []).find((i) => i.name === name)

}

function routeOf(ifaceName, path, method) {
  const i = ifaceOf(ifaceName);
  if (!i) return null;
  const list = i.routes || [];
  let r = list.find((x) => x.path === path && (!method || x.method === method));
  if (!r) r = list.find((x) => x.path === path);
  if (!r && path && path.indexOf(':') >= 0) {
    const norm = path.replace(/:[A-Za-z0-9_]+/g, ':');
    r = list.find((x) => x.path.replace(/:[A-Za-z0-9_]+/g, ':') === norm && (!method || x.method === method));
  }
  return r || null;
}

function apiUrl(ifaceName, path, params) {
  const i = ifaceOf(ifaceName);
  if (!i) throw new Error('接口不存在：' + ifaceName);
  let p = (i.basePath || '') + path;
  if (params) {
    Object.keys(params).forEach((k) => {
      p = p.replace(new RegExp(':' + k + '(?![A-Za-z0-9_])', 'g'), encodeURIComponent(String(params[k])));
    });
  }
  return '/api' + p;
}

async function api(ifaceName, path, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  const method = opts.method || 'GET';
  let url = apiUrl(ifaceName, path, opts.params);
  if (opts.query) {
    const qs = new URLSearchParams();
    Object.keys(opts.query).forEach((k) => {
      const v = opts.query[k];
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') qs.set(k, String(v));
    });
    const s = qs.toString();
    if (s) url += (url.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + s;
  }
  const headers = {};
  if (opts.body !== undefined) headers['content-type'] = 'application/json';
  if (state.token) headers.authorization = 'Bearer ' + state.token;
  let res;
  try {
    res = await fetch(url, { method, headers, body: opts.body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(opts.body) });
  } catch (e) {
    throw new Error('无法连接服务，请确认案例服务已经启动');
  }
  let json = {};
  try { json = await res.json(); } catch (e) { json = {}; }
  if (!res.ok || json.ok === false) {
    const err = new Error(json.message || json.error || ('请求失败 ' + res.status));
    err.status = res.status;
    err.code = json.error || '';
    throw err;
  }
  return json.data === undefined ? json : json.data;
}

function fmtDate(v, withTime) {
  if (!v) return '—';
  const d = new Date(v);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).replace('T', ' ').slice(0, withTime ? 16 : 10);
  const pad = (n) => (n < 10 ? '0' + n : String(n));
  const day = d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
  if (!withTime) return day;
  return day + ' ' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes());
}
function fmtDay(v) {
  if (!v) return '—';
  const d = new Date(v);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v).slice(0, 10);

  return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
}

function fieldInput(ifaceName, name, value) {
  const meta = fieldMeta(ifaceName, name);
  const label = labelOf(ifaceName, name);
  const hint = /(^|\s)\d+\s+\S/.test(String(meta.comment || '')) ? '' : (meta.comment || '');
  const en = enumFor(name, ifaceName);
  const full = isLongField(meta, name) || /(payload|items|answers|questions|tags|images)$/.test(name) ? ' full' : '';
  let input = '';
  if (en) {
    const opts = Object.keys(en).map((k) => '<option value="' + esc(k) + '"' + (String(value) === k ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(en[k]) + '</option>').join('');
    input = '<select data-field="' + esc(name) + '"><option value="">请选择</option>' + opts + '</select>';
  } else if (isLongField(meta, name)) {
    input = '<textarea data-field="' + esc(name) + '" placeholder="' + esc(hint) + '">' + esc(value == null ? '' : value) + '</textarea>';
  } else if (name === 'password' || name === 'secret') {
    input = '<input data-field="' + esc(name) + '" type="password" value="' + esc(value == null ? '' : value) + '">';
  } else if (isNumberField(meta, name)) {
    input = '<input data-field="' + esc(name) + '" type="number" step="any" value="' + esc(value == null ? '' : value) + '" placeholder="' + esc(hint) + '">';
  } else if (isDateField(meta, name)) {
    const v = String(value || '').replace(' ', 'T').slice(0, 16);
    input = '<input data-field="' + esc(name) + '" type="datetime-local" value="' + esc(v) + '">';
  } else {
    input = '<input data-field="' + esc(name) + '" value="' + esc(value == null ? '' : value) + '" placeholder="' + esc(hint) + '">';
  }
  return '<div class="field' + full + '"><label>' + esc(label) + '</label>' + input + '</div>';
}

function formHTML(ifaceName, path, values, fieldsOverride) {
  const r = routeOf(ifaceName, path, 'POST') || routeOf(ifaceName, path, 'PUT') || routeOf(ifaceName, path);
  let names = fieldsOverride && fieldsOverride.length ? fieldsOverride.slice() : ((r && r.body) || []).slice();
  const block = ['id', 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'password_hash', 'only_id', 'user_only_id', 'owner_only_id'];
  const sensitive = (n) => /(password|secret|token|hash|only_id|api_key|private_key|cover_key|file_key|avatar|(^|_)key)$/.test(n);
  const i = ifaceOf(ifaceName);
  const ti = (i && i.tables && (i.tables.find((t) => t.key === (r && r.table)) || i.tables[0])) || {};
  const tableFields = ti.fields || [];
  names = names.filter((n) => block.indexOf(n) < 0 && !sensitive(n));
  const authPath = /(login|register|logout)/.test(path || '');
  if (!authPath) {
    const extra = tableFields.filter((f) => !f.pk && f.hidden && f.writable !== false && block.indexOf(f.name) < 0 && !sensitive(f.name) && names.indexOf(f.name) < 0).map((f) => f.name);
    names = names.concat(extra);
  }
  if (!names.length) {
    if (i && i.tables && i.tables[0]) {
      names = tableFields.filter((f) => !f.pk && f.writable !== false && block.indexOf(f.name) < 0 && !sensitive(f.name)).map((f) => f.name);
    }
  }
  return '<div class="form">' + names.map((n) => fieldInput(ifaceName, n, values ? values[n] : '')).join('') +
    '<div class="form-note">提交后会直接写入真实数据表，并刷新当前页面。</div></div>';
}

function contentRows() { return state.rows[UX.primary.iface] || []; }

async function loadContentRows(force) {
  if (!force && state.rows[UX.primary.iface]) return contentRows();
  const d = await api(UX.primary.iface, UX.primary.list);
  const rows = rowsOf(d);
  state.rows[UX.primary.iface] = rows;
  return rows;
}

async function loadCategories() {
  if (!UX.category) return [];
  if (state.rows[UX.category.iface]) return state.rows[UX.category.iface];
  try {
    const d = await api(UX.category.iface, UX.category.list);
    state.rows[UX.category.iface] = rowsOf(d);
  } catch (e) { state.rows[UX.category.iface] = []; }
  return state.rows[UX.category.iface];
}

function categoryName(list, id) {
  const c = (list || []).find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
  return c ? (c.name || c.title || '') : '';
}

function contentVisible(rows) {
  const statusKey = UX.fields.status;
  const hasPublished = rows.some((r) => String(r[statusKey]) === '1');
  let out = hasPublished ? rows.filter((r) => String(r[statusKey]) === '1') : rows.slice();
  const kw = searchValue().toLowerCase();
  if (kw) out = out.filter((r) => JSON.stringify(r).toLowerCase().indexOf(kw) >= 0);
  if (state.params.category) out = out.filter((r) => String(r[UX.fields.category]) === String(state.params.category));
  return out.sort((a, b) => String(b[UX.fields.date] || b.published_at || b.id).localeCompare(String(a[UX.fields.date] || a.published_at || a.id)));
}

function contentCard(row, catList) {
  const title = row[UX.fields.title] || '未命名';
  const date = row[UX.fields.date] || row.published_at || row.created_at;
  const views = row[UX.fields.views] || 0;
  const cat = categoryName(catList, row[UX.fields.category]) || (row.paper || '');
  const unit = UX.media ? ' 次播放' : ' 次阅读';
  return '<article class="card" onclick="App.openContentItem(' + HQ(row.id) + ')">' +
    '<div class="card-cover">' + coverHtml(row, { label: cat || UX.itemLabel }) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="card-body"><div class="card-kicker"><span>' + esc(cat || UX.kicker) + '</span><span>' + esc(fmtDate(date)) + '</span></div>' +
    '<h3>' + esc(title) + '</h3><p>' + esc(plain(row[UX.fields.body], 120) || '打开查看详情。') + '</p>' +
    '<div class="card-foot"><span>' + esc(views) + unit + '</span><span>' + esc(UX.itemLabel) + ' →</span></div></div></article>';
}

function richBody(text) {
  const src = String(text || '').trim();
  if (!src) return '<p class="muted">作者还没有填正文。</p>';
  const blocks = src.split(/\n{2,}/);
  return blocks.map((b) => {
    const t = b.trim();
    if (!t) return '';
    if (/^#{1,3}\s+/.test(t)) return '<h2>' + esc(t.replace(/^#{1,3}\s+/, '')) + '</h2>';
    if (/^[-*]\s+/m.test(t)) {
      return '<ul>' + t.split('\n').filter((x) => /^[-*]\s+/.test(x.trim())).map((x) => '<li>' + esc(x.replace(/^[-*]\s+/, '')) + '</li>').join('') + '</ul>';
    }
    return '<p>' + esc(t).replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/\n/g, '<br>') + '</p>';
  }).join('');
}

async function loadComments(row) {
  const c = UX.comments;
  if (!c) return [];
  try {
    let path = c.list;
    let query = null;
    if (path.indexOf(':id') >= 0) path = path.replace(':id', row.id);
    else query = { [c.foreign]: row.id };
    const d = await api(c.iface, path, { query });
    return rowsOf(d);
  } catch (e) { return []; }
}

function mediaUrl(row) {
  if (!row) return '';
  const raw = row.file_url || row.file_key || '';
  if (!raw) return '';
  if (/^https?:|^\//.test(raw)) return raw;
  return '/uploads/' + raw.replace(/^uploads\//, '');
}

function mediaBlock(row) {
  if (!UX.media) return '';
  const url = mediaUrl(row);
  if (!url) {
    return '<div class="empty" style="padding:22px;margin:18px 0">' +
      (state.token ? '还没有上传' + (UX.media === 'audio' ? '音频' : '视频') + '。<button class="btn sm primary" style="margin-left:8px" onclick="App.uploadMedia(' + HQ(row.id) + ')">上传文件</button>' : '作者还没有上传' + (UX.media === 'audio' ? '音频' : '视频') + '。') + '</div>';
  }
  const playHandler = UX.primary.play ? ' onplay="App.mediaPlay(' + JSON.stringify(row.id) + ')"' : '';
  return '<div class="media-box" style="margin:18px 0;background:#0d0d0d;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden">' +
    (UX.media === 'audio'
      ? '<div style="padding:18px 20px;color:#eee;font-size:13px">' + esc(row.title || '') + '</div><audio controls preload="metadata" src="' + esc(url) + '" style="width:100%;padding:0 14px 14px"' + playHandler + '></audio>'
      : '<video controls preload="metadata" src="' + esc(url) + '" style="width:100%;display:block;max-height:62vh;background:#000"' + playHandler + '></video>') +
    '</div>';
}

App.mediaPlay = (id) => {
  if (!UX.primary.play || state.played[String(id)]) return;
  state.played[String(id)] = true;
  api(UX.primary.iface, UX.primary.play, { params: { id } }).then(() => {
    const row = (state.rows[UX.primary.iface] || []).find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
    if (row) row[UX.fields.views] = Number(row[UX.fields.views] || 0) + 1;
    const meta = document.querySelector('.article-meta [data-views]');
    if (meta) meta.textContent = String((parseInt(meta.textContent, 10) || 0) + 1) + (UX.media ? ' 次播放' : ' 次阅读');
  }).catch(() => { state.played[String(id)] = false; });
};

App.uploadMedia = (id) => {
  if (!requireAuth('登录后才能上传')) return;
  if (!UX.primary.upload) { toast('这个案例还没有配置上传接口', 'err'); return; }
  const picker = document.createElement('input');
  picker.type = 'file';
  picker.accept = UX.media === 'audio' ? 'audio/*' : 'video/*';
  picker.onchange = async () => {
    const file = picker.files && picker.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    toast('正在上传 ' + file.name + '…', 'ok');
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('file', file, file.name);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(apiUrl(UX.primary.iface, UX.primary.upload, { id }), {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: state.token ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + state.token } : {},
        body: fd,
      });
      const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!res.ok || json.ok === false) throw new Error(json.message || json.error || ('上传失败 ' + res.status));
      toast('上传完成', 'ok');
      await App.render();
    } catch (e) { toast(e.message, 'err'); }
  };
  picker.click();
};

function durationText(value) {
  const sec = Number(value || 0);
  if (!sec) return '';
  return sec < 60 ? Math.round(sec) + ' 秒' : Math.round(sec / 60) + ' 分钟';
}

async function contentItem() {
  const id = state.params.id;
  const p = UX.primary;
  setMain(loadingHtml('正在打开' + UX.itemLabel + '…'));
  try {
    const d = await api(p.iface, p.detail, { params: { id } });
    const row = itemOf(d);
    if (!row || !row.id) throw new Error('内容不存在');
    if (p.read) api(p.iface, p.read, { params: { id } }).catch(() => {});
    const comments = await loadComments(row);
    const cats = await loadCategories();
    const cat = categoryName(cats, row[UX.fields.category]);
    let faved = false;
    if (UX.favorites && state.token) {
      try {
        const f = rowsOf(await api(UX.favorites.iface, UX.favorites.list));
        faved = f.some((x) => String(x[UX.favorites.foreign] || x.id) === String(row.id));
      } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
    }
    const actions = [];
    if (UX.favorites) {
      actions.push('<button class="btn ' + (faved ? 'dark' : '') + '" onclick="App.toggleFavorite(' + HQ(row.id) + ')">' + (faved ? '已收藏' : '收藏') + '</button>');
    }
    if (state.token && UX.auth) {
      actions.push('<button class="btn" onclick="App.editContent(' + HQ(row.id) + ')">编辑</button>');
      if (p.publish) actions.push('<button class="btn" onclick="App.publishContent(' + HQ(row.id) + ')">发布</button>');
    }
    const commentHtml = UX.comments ? (
      '<section class="comments"><h3>讨论 · ' + comments.length + '</h3>' +
      (comments.length ? comments.map((c) => '<div class="comment">' + avatar(c[UX.comments.author] || c.author || '读') +
        '<div class="comment-main"><b>' + esc(c[UX.comments.author] || c.author || '读者') + '</b><time>' + esc(fmtDate(c.created_at, true)) + '</time>' +
        '<p>' + esc(c.content) + '</p></div></div>').join('') : '<div class="empty" style="padding:30px">还没有评论，来说第一句。</div>') +
      (state.token
        ? '<div class="comment-form"><textarea id="comment-text" placeholder="写下你的想法…"></textarea><button class="btn primary" onclick="App.submitComment(' + HQ(row.id) + ')">发表评论</button></div>'
        : '<div class="empty" style="padding:24px">登录后参与讨论。<button class="btn sm primary" style="margin-left:8px" onclick="App.login()">登录</button></div>') +
      '</section>'
    ) : '';
    setMain('<div class="page narrow"><div class="detail-head"><button class="back" onclick="App.goBack(\'collection\')">← 返回' + esc(UX.itemLabel) + '</button>' +
      '<span class="pill">' + esc(cat || UX.itemLabel) + '</span></div>' +
      '<article class="article"><div class="eyebrow">' + esc(UX.kicker) + ' · ' + esc(cat || UX.itemLabel) + '</div>' +
      '<h1>' + esc(row[UX.fields.title] || '未命名') + '</h1>' +
      '<div class="article-meta"><span>' + esc(fmtDate(row[UX.fields.date] || row.created_at, true)) + '</span><span data-views>' + esc(row[UX.fields.views] || 0) + (UX.media ? ' 次播放' : ' 次阅读') + '</span>' +
      (row[UX.fields.duration] ? '<span>' + esc(durationText(row[UX.fields.duration])) + '</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="article-cover">' + coverHtml(row, { label: cat || '' }) + '</div>' +
      mediaBlock(row) +
      ((UX.media && !(row.description || row.intro)) ? '' : '<div class="article-body">' + richBody(UX.media ? (row.description || row.intro) : row[UX.fields.body]) + '</div>') +
      '<div class="article-actions">' + actions.join('') + '<button class="btn" onclick="App.goBack(\'collection\')">继续浏览</button></div>' +
      commentHtml + '</article>' + pageFoot() + '</div>');
  } catch (e) {
    setMain('<div class="page narrow">' + emptyHtml('打不开这个' + UX.itemLabel, e.message) + pageFoot() + '</div>');
  }
}

App.submitComment = async (id) => {
  if (!requireAuth('登录后才能评论')) return;
  const box = $('#comment-text');
  const text = box ? box.value.trim() : '';
  if (!text) { toast('评论不能为空', 'err'); return; }
  const c = UX.comments;
  const body = { content: text };
  body[c.foreign] = id;
  if (c.author === 'author') body.author = (state.user && state.user.name) || '读者';
  else {
    body[c.author] = state.user && state.user.onlyId;
    if (!body[c.author]) { toast('缺少用户身份，请重新登录', 'err'); return; }
  }
  if (c.create === '/comments') body.status = 1;
  try {
    await api(c.iface, c.create, { method: 'POST', body });
    toast('评论已发表', 'ok');
    App.render();
  } catch (e) { toast(e.message, 'err'); }
};

function cart() { return storeGet('cbs-cart:' + (CASE.code || 'case'), []); }
function saveCart(v) { storeSet('cbs-cart:' + (CASE.code || 'case'), v); }
function cartCount() { return cart().reduce((n, x) => n + Number(x.qty || 0), 0); }

function addCart(item, qty) {
  const list = cart();
  const found = list.find((x) => String(x.id) === String(item.id));
  if (found) found.qty = Number(found.qty) + Number(qty || 1);
  else list.push(Object.assign({}, item, { qty: Number(qty || 1) }));
  saveCart(list);
  toast('已加入购物车', 'ok');
  renderChrome();
  App.render();
}
App.addCart = addCart;

function setCartQty(id, delta) {
  const list = cart();
  const found = list.find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
  if (!found) return;
  found.qty = Math.max(1, Number(found.qty) + delta);
  saveCart(list);
  renderChrome();
  App.render();
}
App.setCartQty = setCartQty;

function removeCart(id) {
  saveCart(cart().filter((x) => String(x.id) !== String(id)));
  renderChrome();
  App.render();
}
App.removeCart = removeCart;

function deskMenu() { return (UX.menu || []); }
function deskMenuByView(view) {
  const list = deskMenu();
  return list.find((m) => m.view === view)
    || list.find((m) => m.label === view)
    || list.find((m) => (m.list || '').indexOf('/' + view) === 0)
    || null;
}
function deskActionsFor(scope, menu, row) {
  return (UX.actions || []).filter((a) => {
    if (a.scope !== scope) return false;
    if (a.iface && menu && a.iface !== menu.iface) return false;
    if (a.when && row) return Object.keys(a.when).every((k) => String(row[k]) === String(a.when[k]));
    return true;
  });
}
function deskActionBody(action, row, params) {
  const body = {};
  Object.keys(action.map || {}).forEach((target) => { const src = action.map[target]; body[target] = row[src] != null ? row[src] : params[Object.keys(params)[0]]; });
  return body;
}
function deskParamKey(menu) { return menu && menu.detailKey ? menu.detailKey : 'id'; }
function deskRowKey(menu, row) {
  if (!row) return '';
  if (menu && menu.detailKey && row[menu.detailKey] != null) return row[menu.detailKey];
  return row.id != null ? row.id : (row.order_no || row.tracking_no || row.quote_no || '');
}
function deskTitle(row) {
  if (!row) return '记录';
  return row.title || row.name || row.job_name || row.order_no || row.tracking_no || row.device_no || row.customer_name || ('#' + (row.id == null ? '' : row.id));
}
function deskColumns(menu, rows) {
  if (menu.columns && menu.columns.length) return menu.columns;
  const first = rows && rows[0];
  if (!first) return [];
  return Object.keys(first).filter((k) => !/^(id|only_id|user_only_id|owner_only_id|password_hash|payload)$/.test(k)).slice(0, 7);
}

function deskCacheKey(menu) { return 'desk:' + ((menu && (menu.label || menu.list)) || ''); }

async function deskLoad(menu, force) {
  const iface = menu.iface;
  const key = deskCacheKey(menu);
  if (!force && state.rows[key] && state.rows[key].__path === menu.list) return state.rows[key];
  const d = await api(iface, menu.list);
  const rows = rowsOf(d);
  rows.__path = menu.list;
  state.rows[key] = rows;
  return rows;
}

async function deskAll(force) {
  const out = {};
  for (const menu of deskMenu()) {
    try { out[menu.label] = await deskLoad(menu, force); } catch (e) { out[menu.label] = { __error: e.message }; }
  }
  return out;
}

function statNumber(rows, key) {
  const list = rows || [];
  if (!list.length) return 0;
  if (key && list[0] && list[0][key] != null) return list.reduce((n, r) => n + Number(r[key] || 0), 0);
  return list.length;
}

/* 启动与路由：按模式把视图分派到真实页面。 */
function render() {
  if (!state.token && UX.auth && state.view !== 'home') {
    /* 未登录也允许看首页；需要登录的页面由各视图自己 requireAuth。 */
  }
  switch (UX.mode) {
    case 'content':
      if (state.view === 'home') return contentHome();
      if (state.view === 'collection') return contentCollection();
      if (state.view === 'item') return contentItem();
      if (state.view === 'my') return contentMy();
      if (state.view === 'admin') return contentAdmin();
      return contentHome();
    case 'commerce':
      if (state.view === 'home') return commerceHome();
      if (state.view === 'collection') return commerceCollection();
      if (state.view === 'item') return commerceItem();
      if (state.view === 'cart') return commerceCart();
      if (state.view === 'my') return commerceMy();
      if (state.view === 'order') return commerceOrder();
      if (state.view === 'admin') return commerceAdmin();
      return commerceHome();
    case 'catalog':
      if (state.view === 'home') return catalogHome();
      if (state.view === 'collection') return catalogCollection();
      if (state.view === 'item') return catalogItem();
      if (state.view === 'my') return catalogMy();
      if (state.view === 'admin') return catalogAdmin();
      return catalogHome();
    case 'desk':
      if (state.view === 'home') return deskHome();
      if (state.view === 'collection') return deskCollection();
      if (state.view === 'detail') return deskDetail();
      if (state.view === 'board') return deskBoard();
      if (state.view === 'pending') { state.params = { menu: 1 }; return deskCollection(); }
      if (state.view === 'customers') { state.params = { menu: deskMenu().findIndex((m) => m.label.indexOf('客户') >= 0) }; return deskCollection(); }
      if (state.view === 'routes') { state.params = { menu: deskMenu().findIndex((m) => m.label.indexOf('线路') >= 0) }; return deskCollection(); }
      if (state.view === 'alerts') { state.params = { menu: deskMenu().findIndex((m) => m.label.indexOf('告警') >= 0) }; return deskCollection(); }
      return deskHome();
    case 'chat':
      if (state.view === 'thread') return chatThread();
      return chatHome();
    case 'social':
      if (state.view === 'home') return socialHome();
      if (state.view === 'moment') return socialMoment();
      if (state.view === 'friends') return socialFriends();
      if (state.view === 'messages') return socialMessages();
      if (state.view === 'notifications') return socialNotifications();
      if (state.view === 'profile') return socialProfile();
      return socialHome();
    default:
      return contentHome();
  }
}
App.render = render;

function boot() {
  loadSession();
  renderChrome();
  refreshMe().finally(() => { renderChrome(); App.render(); });
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
else boot();
